Existing post-training quantization (PTQ) methods are poorly suited to WAMs because they rely on open-loop objectives, homogeneous model assumptions, and calibration distributions that do not reflect deployment. We present QuantWAMs, a PTQ framework that aligns quantization decisions with the calibration context defined by model structure, rollout distribution, and task objective. QuantWAMs introduces three strategies: shared-basis outlier calibration, which pools activation evidence only across coordinate-compatible modules; co-training-objective saliency, which computes empirical-Fisher scores from the joint video--action gradient and assigns weight precision at a calibration-stable layer granularity; and fixed-intervention rollout auditing, which revises denoising-step protection schedules using reachable closed-loop states without changing the precision budget. We evaluate QuantWAMs on Fast-WAM and LingBot-VA across RoboTwin 2.0, LIBERO, and real-robot manipulation with an AgiBot G2. Under a W4A4-dominant setting, the reported simulation means differ from FP16 by 0.2--0.7 percentage points. Real-robot trials further establish deployment feasibility on three manipulation tasks. For the targeted video and action blocks, QuantWAMs reduces peak weight-and-activation memory to about 29\% of FP16 and provides 1.4--1.6$\times$ block-level speedups.

</details>


### [280] [When Derived Measurements Mislead: Quantifying and Mitigating LLM Over-Trust with Privileged-Modality Reliability Evidence](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28421)
*Zongheng Guo,Tao Chen,Tianli Li,Mingzhe Cui,Yang Jiao,Lei Xie,Yi Pan,Xiao Hu,Manuela Ferrario*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文定义了派生特征过度信任（DFOT）——下游大语言模型将派生测量值当作直接事实或超出其有效范围使用的问题。以生理传感为例，通过D1（接受与离线ECG矛盾的PPG衍生节律）和D2（拒绝离线确认可靠的PPG节律）两个测试，引入五个估计量（COTR、CIR、CRR、ESRM、UHR）量化该问题，并在50,000条PPG-ECG配对记录上使用ECG-to-PPG特权蒸馏作为基线进行验证。基线在四个修复和特异性指标上提升1.82-6.69个百分点，所有配对置信区间排除零；UHR增加0.67个百分点（95% CI: -0.4至+1.7）。DFOT为更强缓解方法提供了统一评估目标。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 派生测量值越来越多地被直接当作事实输入大语言模型管道，但其有效性依赖于具体实例，导致模型可能错误信任这些测量值或超出有效范围使用它们。现有研究缺乏对这种派生特征过度信任（DFOT）问题的系统性定义和量化方法，因此需要建立统一的评估框架来检测和缓解该问题。

Method: 本文以生理传感为例，构建D1（测试LLM是否接受离线ECG矛盾的PPG衍生节律）和D2（测试LLM是否拒绝离线ECG确认可靠的PPG节律）两个测试。设计五个估计量：冲突过度信任率（COTR）和上下文诱导错误率（CIR）分别表征D1/D2；正确修复率（CRR）衡量冻结错误修复；证据特异性修复边际（ESRM）对比匹配与患者分离的洗牌证据；效用危害率（UHR）衡量高可靠性案例中不必要的验证。该框架不依赖特定可靠性生成器，在50,000条PPG-ECG配对记录上使用ECG-to-PPG特权蒸馏作为基线进行演示。

Result: 在协议锁定的187名患者测试集上，基线（ECG-to-PPG特权蒸馏）相比纯PPG推理在四个修复和特异性端点（COTR、CIR、CRR、ESRM）上提升1.82-6.69个百分点，所有配对置信区间排除零；UHR增加0.67个百分点（95% CI: -0.4至+1.7），即不必要的验证略有增加但统计不显著。

Conclusion: DFOT问题确实存在且可量化，提出的框架为评估和比较不同缓解方法提供了统一目标。ECG-to-PPG特权蒸馏作为基线方法能有效改善大多数DFOT指标，但可能轻微增加不必要的验证。未来需要开发更强的缓解方法来进一步降低DFOT。

Abstract: Derived measurements increasingly enter large language model (LLM) pipelines as direct facts despite their instance-dependent validity. We define derived-feature over-trust (DFOT) as the failure in which a downstream LLM assigns such a measurement the epistemic status of a direct fact or uses it outside its valid scope. Using physiological sensing as a case study, D1 tests acceptance of a PPG-derived rhythm contradicted by offline ECG, whereas D2 tests rejection of an offline-confirmed reliable PPG rhythm under misleading severe history. ECG supplies training supervision and offline reference construction but is never shown to the LLM. Five estimands quantify this chain: conflict over-trust rate (COTR) and context-induced error rate (CIR) characterize D1/D2; correct repair rate (CRR) measures frozen-error repair; evidence-specific repair margin (ESRM) contrasts matched and patient-disjoint shuffled evidence; and utility harm rate (UHR) measures unnecessary verification among HIGH-reliability cases used without verification at baseline. The framework does not depend on a particular reliability generator. We demonstrate it on 50,000 paired PPG-ECG records using ECG-to-PPG privileged distillation as an illustrative baseline and PPG-only inference. On a protocol-locked 187-patient test, the baseline improves four repair and specificity endpoints by 1.82-6.69 percentage points, with all paired confidence intervals excluding zero; UHR increases by 0.67 percentage points (95% CI: -0.4 to +1.7). DFOT provides a common evaluation target for stronger mitigation methods. The code is available at https://github.com/Zongheng-Guo/When-Derived-Measurements-Mislead.

</details>


### [281] [A foundation model of numerical intelligence with cross-disciplinary generalization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28432)
*Chenghan Wu,Zongmin Yu,Liu Yang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出数值智能（numerical intelligence）概念，并介绍UNICON（统一上下文操作网络）作为跨学科的基础模型，能够从数值上下文中推断和运用知识。UNICON通过图结构示例学习系统间的预测关系，无需重新训练即可在多种科学和社会系统中接近专家性能，与语言模型结合后甚至超越未训练学科的最先进专家。训练语料的多样性提升了模型向未见学科的泛化能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有大语言模型擅长从文本上下文中获取和运用知识，但智能不应局限于语言。科学和社会系统需要能够从数值上下文中获取和运用知识的模型，即数值智能。目前缺乏跨学科的数值智能基础模型。

Method: 提出UNICON（UNified In-Context Operator Networks），一种基于Transformer的上下文学习框架。以系统生成的图结构示例作为上下文，UNICON推断其中共享的预测关系，并将其应用于同一系统的查询。通过大规模多学科数据训练，并可与语言模型智能体协同工作。

Result: UNICON在多个科学和社会系统中达到接近专家水平的性能，包括训练中未见过的学科。与语言模型结合后，在未训练学科上超越最先进的专家模型。训练语料多样性越高，模型向未见学科的泛化能力越强。

Conclusion: UNICON可作为数值智能的基础模型，为更广泛的人工智能生态系统提供构建模块，证明数值智能可以像语言智能一样通过上下文学习实现跨领域泛化。

Abstract: Intelligence is commonly understood as the ability to acquire and apply knowledge, adapt to unfamiliar situations and solve new problems. Large language models exhibit this capacity by inferring task-relevant knowledge from textual context and applying it to new tasks. Yet intelligence need not be confined to language. For scientific and social systems, we need models that acquire and apply knowledge from numerical context-an ability we call numerical intelligence. Here we introduce UNified In-Context Operator Networks (UNICON), a foundation model that exhibits numerical intelligence across disciplines. Using graph-based examples from a system as context, UNICON infers the predictive relation shared across them and applies it to queries from the same system. Across scientific and social systems, including those from disciplines absent from training, the same model approaches specialist performance without retraining. Combining UNICON with language-model agents yields further gains, enabling it to surpass state-of-the-art specialists in a discipline unseen in training. We further show that training-corpus diversity improves generalization to unseen disciplines. Together, these results establish UNICON as a foundation model of numerical intelligence and position it as a building block for a broader ecosystem of artificial intelligence.

</details>


### [282] [LeanCSP: A Framework for Certifying Constraint Reformulation and Solving in Lean](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28459)
*Pablo Manrique,Stefan Szeider*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文在 Lean 定理证明器中构建了一个双重验证框架：一方面可针对整个问题族参数化地证明等价性、可满足等价性及对称性破缺等规约层性质，另一方面通过翻译后端（MiniZinc、SMT-LIB、OPB）检查求解器生成的证书，从而实现不依赖外部求解器的端到端可满足性验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 约束编程的结果需要两层保证：规约变换必须保持语义，求解器必须给出正确答案。现有方法通常信任求解器或仅验证单层性质，缺乏通用的形式化验证手段。

Method: 在 Lean 中提出统一框架，支持：(1) 在问题族层面参数化地证明规约性质（等价、可满足等价、对称性破缺）；(2) 通过翻译后端将证书导出为 MiniZinc、SMT-LIB、OPB 格式并检查；(3) 两层结合形成不信任外部求解器的端到端工作流。

Result: 实验表明，单个参数化证明可重用于所有实例规模，将求解器搜索开销降低最多 2×10⁷ 倍；完整的 Lean 内证书验证在最⼤实例上仅需数分钟。

Conclusion: 该框架实现了不依赖外部求解器的约束问题可满足性验证，且经过验证的对称性破缺在实践中效果显著，证明了形式化验证既可靠又可行。

Abstract: Constraint programming is a core technology for solving complex combinatorial problems in scheduling, planning, configuration, and verification. Trusting its results therefore demands guarantees at two levels: that reformulations applied beforehand are semantics-preserving, and that solvers produce correct answers. In this work, we introduce a framework that addresses both verification levels in the Lean theorem prover: it can be used to prove formulation-level properties, such as equivalence, equisatisfiability, and the correctness of symmetry-breaking constraints, parametrically for entire problem families; and to check solver-produced certificates for individual instances via translation backends to external formats such as MiniZinc, SMT-LIB, and OPB. Combining both levels yields an end-to-end workflow that establishes the satisfiability or unsatisfiability of a constraint problem without trusting the external solver. Experimental results show that our framework's verified symmetry breaking also pays off in practice: a single parametric proof per problem family, reused across all instance sizes, reduces solver search effort by a factor of up to 2x10^7, while the entire in-Lean certification stays affordable, taking at most a few minutes for our largest instances.

</details>


### [283] [A report-grounded vision-language foundation model for colonoscopy from 280000 routine reports](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28466)
*Jia Yu,Yan Zhu,Yili He,Zilong Wang,Xinyang Jiang,Peiyao Fu,Ruijie Yang,Tianyi Chen,Siyuan Li,Zhihua Wang,Fei Wu,Quanlin Li,Xian Yang,Pinghong Zhou,Shuo Wang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: EndoCLIP 是一个针对结肠镜的视觉-语言基础模型，通过从 280,476 份常规结肠镜报告中渐进式恢复出 125,756 个病灶级别的图像-文本对进行训练。在病灶级检索、结构化报告生成和六个多中心分类任务上，EndoCLIP 在零样本和线性探测设置下均优于通用和生物医学视觉-语言编码器；在良恶性分类上，其线性探测性能接近 12 名内镜医师的专家水平。结果表明，恢复发现-帧对应关系可将常规文档转化为可扩展的监督信号，使临床目标可通过语言指定而非为每个任务单独标注。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前视觉-语言模型在结肠镜中应用不足，尽管常规报告中包含丰富的专家描述（如病灶外观、大小、位置），但这些报告总结的是整个过程而非单帧字幕，导致临床发现与对应图像的关联很弱。因此，需要一种方法利用这些常规文档来建立图像-文本的细粒度对应，从而提供可扩展的监督信号。

Method: 从 280,476 份常规结肠镜报告中，通过渐进式方法恢复出 125,756 个病灶级别的图像-文本对，训练得到 EndoCLIP 模型。该模型基于对比学习框架（类似 CLIP），对齐病灶图像和对应的文本描述。训练后，模型可进行零样本和线性探测的病灶级检索、结构化报告生成以及多种分类任务。

Result: 在病灶级图像-文本检索、结构化报告生成和六个多中心临床分类任务上，EndoCLIP 在零样本和线性探测设置下均优于通用和生物医学视觉-语言编码器。在良恶性分类任务中，其线性探测的性能接近 12 名内镜医师在盲法研究中的表现。

Conclusion: 恢复发现-帧对应关系可将常规文档转化为可扩展的监督信号，使临床目标能够以语言形式指定，而无需为每个任务单独进行人工标注，从而推动视觉-语言模型在结肠镜中的实际应用。

Abstract: Vision-language models remain underused in colonoscopy despite the rich expert descriptions recorded in routine reports. These reports document lesion appearance, size and location but summarise entire procedures rather than caption individual frames, leaving clinical findings only weakly linked to the corresponding images. Here we develop EndoCLIP, a colonoscopy vision-language foundation model trained on 125,756 lesion-level image-text pairs progressively recovered from 280,476 routine colonoscopy records. Across lesion-level image-text retrieval, structured report generation and six multi-centre clinical classification tasks, EndoCLIP outperforms general-purpose and biomedical vision-language encoders in both zero-shot and linear-probe settings. On benign-versus-malignant classification, its linear probe approaches the performance of expert readers in a blinded study involving 12 endoscopists. These results suggest that recovering finding-to-frame correspondence can transform routine documentation into scalable supervision, enabling clinical targets to be specified in language rather than separately annotated for each task.

</details>


### [284] [Towards Autonomous Aircraft Surveillance from Nanosatellites through On-Board Inference and Generative Data Augmentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28470)
*Antonio Delgado-Rosa,David Muñoz-Valero,Enrique Adrian Villarrubia-Martin,Juan Moreno-Garcia*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出一种结合星上推理与生成式数据增强的工作流，在6U立方星上用低功耗边缘张量加速器进行推理，并通过扩散模型生成少数类合成图像来平衡数据集，从而提升对空监视的性能，实现实时自主决策。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 纳米卫星下行链路预算有限，传统方式需传输大量原始图像到地面处理，而开放卫星飞机数据集稀缺且类别严重不平衡，导致决策延迟或标准检测器难以学习少数类的鲁棒表示。

Method: 在6U立方星上搭载低功耗边缘张量加速器执行星上推理；使用低秩适配微调的扩散模型生成少数类合成图像，并由中间检测器自动伪标注，再与经典增强样本合并，形成平衡数据集。

Result: 平衡数据集使全局mAP从77.9%提升至82.2%，少数类F1从0.683提升至0.811；量化后的检测器适配星上内存，在轨可处理25-30帧/秒。

Conclusion: 该工作流区别于传统的弯管架构（卫星仅作为被动数据收集器），计算测试表明其可作为纳米卫星实时自主对空监视的决策支持工具。

Abstract: Airborne surveillance from low Earth orbit is hindered by two interconnected bottlenecks: nanosatellites have a limited downlink budget, yet the conventional approach still transmits terabytes of raw imagery to the ground for processing, and open satellite datasets for aircraft are scarce and severely class-imbalanced. These limitations either delay timely decision-making or prevent standard detectors from learning robust representations of rare aircraft classes. In this paper, a workflow that combines on-board inference with generative data augmentation is proposed to address both limitations jointly. Inference is executed on a 6U CubeSat equipped with a low-power edge tensor accelerator, while a diffusion model fine-tuned through low-rank adaptation generates synthetic minority-class imagery. This synthetic output is automatically annotated, pseudo-labelled, by an intermediate detector and merged with classically augmented samples. The results show that the balanced dataset increases global mean average precision from 77.9% to 82.2%, with the minority class rising from F1=0.683 to F1=0.811, and that the quantised detector fits the on-chip memory and projects 25-30 frames per second on orbit. This approach contrasts with the conventional bent-pipe architecture, in which the satellite acts as a passive data collector. Therefore, the computational tests support the proposed workflow as a decision-support tool for real-time, autonomous airborne surveillance from nanosatellites.

</details>


### [285] [A Fuzzy Rule-based Neuro-Symbolic Approach for Pipe Severity Prediction in Sewer Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28481)
*Ngoc Thai Le,Thanh Ma,Umberto Straccia*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种模块化的模糊规则神经符号框架，用于自动化下水道管道缺陷严重性评估。该框架将神经网络感知（Swin Transformer预测14种缺陷代码）与符号推理（从决策树提取的19条模糊IF-THEN规则）解耦，通过模糊逻辑（t-norm/s-norm）组合生成可解释的严重性分类。在3244张高度不平衡的图像数据集上，该方法相比纯图像分类在准确率、平衡准确率、Macro F1和MCC上分别提升17.9%、12.2%、23.0%和17.3%，同时保持了可追溯的推理链。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有自动下水道管道严重性评估方法直接对图像进行分类，形成“黑箱”模型，视觉缺陷与最终严重性评分之间的联系是隐式的，缺乏可解释性。

Method: 提出模块化模糊规则神经符号框架：（1）感知模块：Swin Transformer从图像预测14种多标签检查代码（CODE）；（2）推理模块：用Weka的J48决策树在真实CODE和严重性标签上训练，将决策树路径转换为19条固定的IF-THEN规则；（3）推理使用模糊逻辑：CODE条件的t-norm激活由规则置信度加权，再与对应的s-norm组合，产生可解释的类别证据。评估了Product、Łukasiewicz和Hamacher三种算子对。

Result: 在3244张图像（5个高度不平衡的严重性类别）上，与纯图像分类相比，准确率提升17.9%，平衡准确率提升12.2%，Macro F1提升23.0%，MCC提升17.3%。真实标签由5个独立大语言模型分析原始检查员笔记一致生成。

Conclusion: 该框架在保持竞争性的类别平衡性能的同时，提供了从预测CODE度到规则支持再到严重性证据的可追溯推理，弥合了神经感知与符号推理之间的差距，增强了模型的可解释性。

Abstract: Standard automated sewer pipe severity assessment relies on direct image classification, creating a "black box" where the link between visual defects and final severity scores remains implicit. This study introduces a modular, fuzzy rule-based neuro-symbolic framework that bridges this gap by decoupling neural perception from symbolic reasoning. The perception module utilizes a Swin Transformer to predict 14 multilabel inspection CODE degrees directly from images. For reasoning, a DT, specifically Weka's J48, algorithm is trained on ground-truth CODEs and severity labels, and its paths are converted into 19 fixed IF--THEN rules. Inference operates via fuzzy logic: t-norm activations from CODE conditions are weighted by rule confidence and combined with corresponding s-norms to produce interpretable class evidence. We assessed Product, Łukasiewicz, and Hamacher operator pairs using a dataset of 3,244 images spanning five highly imbalanced severity classes. Ground-truth labels were robustly generated via consensus from five independent large language models analyzing original inspector notes. Our results show an improvement of accuracy, balanced accuracy, Macro F1 and MCC by 17.9%, 12.2%, 23.0%, and 17.3%, respectively, over image-only based classification.
  Overall, the framework combines competitive class-balanced performance with traceable reasoning from predicted CODE degrees to rule supports and severity evidence.

</details>


### [286] [SCOPE: Supply-Chain Operations through Coupled Policies for End-to-End Coordination](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28488)
*Yunhao Liang,Xianqi Cao,Pujun Zhang,Yuan Qu,Yongzhi Qi,Ningxuan Kang,Max Z. J. Shen*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出SCOPE框架，通过复合策略模型将供应链中原本分离的决策（品类组合、补货频率、分配源、运输路线）进行端到端协调，利用共享的操作表示和分token决策接口，在生鲜零售补货场景中验证了优于分离优化方法的效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代供应链中品类选择、货源分配、补货频率和路线规划等决策通常由不同部门独立优化，导致库存短缺、积压和不必要的运输成本。亟需一种端到端统一规划方法来捕捉这些决策之间的操作耦合。

Method: 提出SCOPE复合策略模型，将供应链实体表示为令牌，通过共享的操作表示进行上下文化，并为每种令牌类型映射到对应的决策接口，使每个决策基于部分计划构建，最终用系统级效用评估完整计划。

Result: 在叮咚买菜和京东两个不同补货层级的大规模供应链真实运营数据上，SCOPE持续优于分别优化各决策阶段的方法以及业界常用基线。

Conclusion: 学习和协调跨部门的操作耦合能够产生更有效的端到端供应链决策，验证了统一规划相比分离优化的优势。

Abstract: Can supply-chain AI move beyond isolated decision modules toward unified operational planning? A complete replenishment plan specifies which products each location carries, which upstream facility supplies it, how often it is replenished, and how deliveries are routed. These decisions are operationally coupled: the selected assortment changes the demand and load passed to later stages; source assignment and replenishment frequency reshape the delivery requests; and route feasibility and cost, in turn, determine the system value of the earlier choices. Yet in modern supply chains, these decisions are often handled by separate departments and optimized through separate systems, which can lead to stockouts, inventory exposure, and avoidable transportation. We propose SCOPE: Supply-Chain Operations through Coupled Policies for End-to-End Coordination, a composite policy model that represents supply-chain entities as tokens, contextualizes them through a shared operational representation, and maps each token type to the corresponding decision interface. Each decision builds on the partial plan formed by earlier decisions while the completed plan is evaluated using a shared system-level utility. We instantiate this framework in urban fresh-retail replenishment, where service frequency, assortment, capacity pressure, and road-network routing interact strongly, and evaluate it on real operational data from Dingdong and JD.com, two large-scale supply chains operating at different replenishment echelons. Across both settings, SCOPE consistently outperforms methods that optimize each decision stage separately, as well as practice-oriented baselines commonly used in supply-chain operations. These results show that learning and coordinating cross-department operational couplings lead to more effective end-to-end supply-chain decisions.

</details>


### [287] [InfoOps Bench: A live information operations safety benchmark](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28503)
*Dorian Quelle,Lisa-Maria Neudert,Jonathan Bright,John Gallacher*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出一个动态更新的AI基准测试，用于评估前沿语言模型被国家支持信息行动利用的完整性。该基准基于实时监控管道中超过2100个来自俄罗斯、中国和伊朗的信息行动，并每周更新。测试了8家供应商的17个模型，发现大多数模型可被利用，完整性评分（拒绝请求的百分比）范围从8.8%到94.5%，差距达85.7个百分点，且与模型大小无关。模型选择会改变输出特性，部分模型会编造细节、产生比源材料更有害的输出，而另一些则会在服从的同时化解声明。中国开发的模型在涉及对中国事实性但批评性的声明时，合规率急剧下降。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 评估和持续监控前沿语言模型被国家支持信息行动（如俄罗斯、中国、伊朗）利用的脆弱性，以衡量模型的完整性并推动安全性改进。

Method: 构建一个动态基准，从实时监控管道中提取超过2100个信息行动，每周更新跟踪的声明。在四种提示框架下测试来自8个提供商的17个模型，计算完整性评分（拒绝率），并分析模型输出在事实核查、细节添加等方面的差异。

Result: 完整性评分范围从8.8%到94.5%，差异达85.7个百分点，且与模型大小无关。模型选择显著影响输出：有的模型编造细节并产生比原始材料更有害的内容，有的则化解声明即使遵从时也会化解。事实核查率从2.9%到72.9%。中国开发的模型（除智谱GLM 5.2外）在事实正确但批评中国的声明上合规率骤降48-70个百分点。

Conclusion: 完整性至少部分与模型对良性声明的拒绝能力有关，体现了平衡可用性与安全性的挑战。动态基准因其持续更新而抗饱和，为评估LLM受信息行动影响提供了持续监测手段。

Abstract: In this paper we present an active, constantly updated AI benchmark which measures the integrity of frontier language models against being co-opted for state-backed information operations. We draw on over 2,100 information operations from a live monitoring pipeline which tracks Russian, Chinese and Iranian state-backed information assets. Alongside this paper, we release a companion website that tracks the most prominent claims spread by state-backed media outlets, updated weekly, available from: pattrn.ai/research/infoopsbench. The dynamic nature of the benchmark makes it resistant to saturation.
  In the benchmark, we test 17 models from 8 providers across four prompt framings. We find that most models can be co-opted for information operations. Integrity scores, defined as the percentage of refused requests, range from 8.8% to 94.5%, an 85.7-percentage-point spread not explained by model size. Model choice also changes the character of the resulting operation. Some models fabricate details and produce output more harmful than the source material, others defuse claims even while complying, and fact-checking rates vary from 2.9% to 72.9%.
  Integrity against information operations is at least partly related to refusal to produce content even for benign claims, illustrating the challenge of balancing model usability with safety. With one exception (Z.ai's GLM 5.2), the Chinese-developed models sharply cut compliance on factually grounded but China-critical claims, dropping 48-70 percentage points relative to matched benign claims.

</details>


### [288] [Selective Credibility-Limited Belief Update](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28523)
*Theofanis Aravanis,Costas D. Koutras*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出选择性可信限制信念更新（selective credibility-limited belief update），该框架允许将认知输入相对于每个源世界转换为较弱的代理，然后执行可信限制转换，从而克服了现有方法将认知输入视为不可分割整体的局限，能够表达仅部分实现复合认知输入的情况。论文提供了语义和公理刻画，识别了两个良构子类（一致性保持和最大一致性保持更新算子），并证明了经典Katsuno-Mendelzon更新和可信限制更新均为该框架的特例，从而形成了一个统一且表达能力更强的信念更新框架。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准Katsuno-Mendelzon信念更新假设从每个初始可能世界都能完全纳入认知输入，而可信限制信念更新则对每个源世界限制后继世界为可信或可达的。然而，现有可信限制方法将认知输入视为不可分割的整体，无法处理仅部分实现复合认知输入的情况，这限制了其表达能力。本文旨在克服这一局限，提出更灵活的信念更新框架。

Method: 提出选择性可信限制信念更新框架：在执行可信限制转换之前，将认知输入相对于每个源世界转换为一个较弱的代理（proxy）。给出了该算子类的语义刻画（通过可能世界模型上的转换函数和可信限制函数）和公理刻画（一组合理性公理）。进一步识别了两个子类：一致性保持更新算子（要求每当原始认知输入一致时，转换后的认知输入从源世界看是可信的）和最大一致性保持更新算子（额外要求所选代理在原始认知输入的可信后果中信息量最大）。通过调整参数，证明现有框架均可作为特例恢复。

Result: 建立了选择性可信限制信念更新算子的语义与公理表征。证明了可信限制信念更新是该框架的特例（当转换函数为恒等映射时），而Katsuno-Mendelzon信念更新则在移除可信限制且转换函数为恒等映射时恢复。所识别的两个子类保证了良好行为（一致性保持和最大信息量）。整体框架严格强于现有方法，支持源依赖的选择性接受。

Conclusion: 该工作提供了一个统一且更具表达力的信念更新框架，整合了经典KM更新和可信限制更新，同时支持更细粒度的源依赖选择性接受。理论结果（语义与公理对应、子类识别）表明该框架是合理且富有成效的，为信念变化研究开辟了新方向。

Abstract: Belief update concerns changes in an agent's beliefs induced by changes in the underlying world. Standard Katsuno-Mendelzon update assumes that an epistemic input can be incorporated from every initially possible world, whereas credibility-limited belief update restricts, for each source world, the successor worlds regarded as credible or reachable. Nevertheless, existing credibility-limited approaches treat the epistemic input as an indivisible whole, and therefore cannot represent cases in which only part of a compound epistemic input can be realized. We introduce selective credibility-limited belief update, in which the epistemic input is transformed, relative to each source world, into a weaker proxy before the credibility-limited transition is performed. We provide semantic and axiomatic characterizations of the resulting class of update operators. We then identify two well-behaved sub-classes; namely, consistency-preserving update operators, which require every transformed epistemic input to be credible from its source world whenever the original epistemic input is consistent, and maximal consistency-preserving update operators, which additionally require the selected proxy to be maximally informative among the credible consequences of the original epistemic input. Finally, we establish the generality of the proposed framework by showing that credibility-limited belief update is recovered as a special case, while Katsuno--Mendelzon belief update emerges when credibility restrictions are removed and the transformation functions are taken to be identities. These results demonstrate that the framework provides a unified and strictly more expressive account of belief update, encompassing established approaches while supporting source-dependent selective acceptance.

</details>


### [289] [MANTA: Multi-Agent Network Topology Adaptation for Self-Evolving Multi-Agent Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28527)
*Mao-xun Huang,Jerry Wang,Yi-Cheng Lai,Zhengxin Zhang,Claire Cardie,Hen-Hsen Huang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: MANTA 是一个多智能体网络拓扑自适应框架，允许通信结构在推理时自我进化，通过初始化任务条件拓扑、监控协作轨迹并执行有界结构更新，在五个基准测试中平均得分74.0，比最强基线高出5.8个百分点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的大语言模型多智能体系统通常将通信拓扑视为固定设计或离线优化目标，缺乏在推理时动态调整的能力，限制了系统适应复杂任务的能力。

Method: MANTA 在执行前从先验结构经验初始化任务条件拓扑；在部署期间监控协作轨迹，当当前组织不足时执行有界结构更新，可修改智能体角色、通信链接、执行顺序、信息可见性和验证路径，同时保留任务接口和智能体预算。

Result: 在五个基准测试（信息检索、工具使用、规划、工作流执行、数学推理）上，MANTA 平均得分74.0，比最强基线高出5.8个百分点，并在 PlanCraft 上取得最佳结果。

Conclusion: 推理时的自我改进可以扩展到协作架构本身，动态调整通信拓扑能显著提升多智能体系统的性能。

Abstract: Large language model-based multi-agent systems improve complex problem solving through task decomposition, agent specialization, information exchange, and intermediate validation. However, existing systems typically treat communication topology as a fixed design choice or an offline optimization target. We introduce MANTA, a framework for Multi-Agent Network Topology Adaptation that enables communication structures to self-evolve at inference time. Before execution, MANTA initializes a task-conditioned topology from prior structural experience. During deployment, it monitors collaboration traces and applies bounded structural updates when the current organization becomes insufficient. These updates can modify agent roles, communication links, execution order, information visibility, and validation pathways while preserving the task interface and agent budget. We evaluate MANTA against representative single-agent and multi-agent baselines on five benchmarks spanning information seeking, tool use, planning, workflow execution, and mathematical reasoning. MANTA achieves the highest average score of 74.0, outperforming the strongest baseline by 5.8 percentage points and obtaining the best result on PlanCraft. These results show that inference-time self-improvement can extend to the architecture of collaboration itself.

</details>


### [290] [Rethinking Inference-Time Scaling in Local Computer-Use Agents: Failure Modes and Compute Tradeoffs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28573)
*Woongkyu Lee,Jungwook Choi*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文系统研究了资源受限的本地计算机使用代理（CUA）在推理时扩展的效果，发现额外计算往往导致收益递减并改变失败模式，建议采用选择性计算分配和失败感知控制机制。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 本地部署CUA对隐私、成本效率和实际可用性日益重要，但在严格硬件约束下提升性能仍具挑战。虽然推理时扩展在尖端CUA中有效，但其对资源受限的本地模型的效果尚不明确。

Method: 在OSWorld基准上，对Qwen3-VL-8B/30B-A3B、UI-TARS-1.5-7B和OpenCUA-7B等本地CUA模型，从上下文、时间、结构和并行四个维度进行了推理时扩展的系统实证研究。

Result: 额外计算常导致收益递减并改变失败模式：上下文扩展提升轨迹稳定性但收益饱和，失败从重复/停滞转向过早虚假成功；时间扩展减少最大步骤停滞但未显著提高任务成功率；结构分解带来规划和格式化开销；并行扩展部分缓解失败但计算成本高昂。

Conclusion: 高效本地CUA需要选择性计算分配、失败感知控制机制，以及围绕本地模型能力与限制设计的代理框架。

Abstract: Deploying autonomous computer-use agents (CUAs) locally is increasingly important for privacy, cost efficiency, and practical usability, yet improving their performance under strict hardware constraints remains challenging. While recent studies show that inference-time scaling can improve frontier computer-use agents through additional computation during execution, its effectiveness for resource-constrained local models remains poorly understood. We present a systematic empirical study of inference-time scaling in local CUAs across contextual, temporal, structural, and parallel dimensions. We evaluate Qwen3-VL-8B/30B-A3B, UI-TARS-1.5-7B, and OpenCUA-7B on the OSWorld benchmark. Our results show that additional computation often yields diminishing returns while changing failure modes. Contextual scaling provides historical grounding that improves trajectory stability and task accuracy, but its gains saturate as token cost increases and failures shift from repetitive or stalled trajectories toward premature false successes. Temporal scaling similarly reduces max-step stalls, yet does not substantially improve task success, indicating that longer horizons often extend erroneous trajectories rather than correct them. We further find that structural decomposition can introduce planning and formatting overhead in local two-stage agents, while parallel scaling partially mitigates these failures at a substantial computational cost. Overall, our findings suggest that efficient local CUAs require selective compute allocation, failure-aware control mechanisms, and agentic frameworks designed around the capabilities and limitations of local models.

</details>


### [291] [DualG-MRAG: Decoupling Macro-Reasoning and Micro-Matching for Multimodal Retrieval-Augmented Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28580)
*Jiacheng Tao,Qingyun Sun,Haonan Yuan,Ziwei Zhang,Jianxin Li*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: DualG-MRAG 提出了一个双层级框架，解耦宏观推理与微观匹配图，以解决多模态 RAG 中复杂多跳推理的难题，在证据召回和复杂 QA 准确率上超越现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有多模态 RAG 在处理复杂多跳推理时表现不佳，主要依赖独立实例级匹配而缺乏跨模态/文档的关系建模。图增强方法虽引入结构建模，但面临两难：细粒度视觉特征导致图快速膨胀和检索噪声，粗粒度表示则丢失关键局部证据。

Method: 提出 DualG-MRAG 双层级框架，包含：1) Macro Graph 用于全局拓扑路由，Micro Graph 用于细粒度局部验证，通过解耦隔离全局推理与局部匹配以抑制噪声；2) 基于 GNN 的检索器将检索建模为查询驱动的消息传递过程；3) 动态规划解码机制从 GNN 前向传播中提取显式推理路径，替代孤立文档块作为生成模型的输入。

Result: 实验表明 DualG-MRAG 在证据召回和复杂 QA 准确率上均优于基线方法。

Conclusion: 通过解耦宏观推理与微观匹配，DualG-MRAG 有效解决了多模态 RAG 中图增强方法面临的两难困境，在复杂多跳推理任务上取得更优性能。

Abstract: While Multimodal Retrieval-Augmented Generation (MM-RAG) has shown promising results, it still struggles with complex multi-hop reasoning tasks. Existing methods primarily focus on independent instance-level matching, which often fails to capture explicit relationships across modalities and documents. Although Graph-enhanced methods introduce structural modeling, they face a fundamental challenge in multimodal scenarios: incorporating fine-grained visual features leads to rapid graph expansion and retrieval noise, whereas coarse-grained representations cause the discarding of critical local evidence. To address this dilemma, we propose DualG-MRAG, a Dual-tier framework that introduces a decoupled architecture comprising Macro-reasoning and Micro-matching Graphs for Multimodal RAG. Specifically, to suppress retrieval noise by isolating global structural reasoning from fine-grained evidence matching, we construct a Macro Graph for global topological routing and a Micro Graph for precise local verification. Subsequently, to enable dynamic relevance propagation across heterogeneous evidence sources, we formulate retrieval as a query-driven message passing process via a GNN Retriever. Furthermore, to provide the generative model with coherent structural guidance, we introduce a dynamic programming decoding mechanism that extracts explicit reasoning paths directly from the GNN's forward pass, replacing the standard input of isolated document chunks. Extensive experiments demonstrate that DualG-MRAG outperforms baselines in both evidence recall and complex QA accuracy.

</details>


<div id='cs.LG'></div>

# cs.LG [[Back]](#toc)

### [292] [QQWorld: Quantile-Quantile Matching for World Model Regularization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.28415)
*Zhoushun Yu,Xiaoyu Hu,Xiangyu Xu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了 QQWorld，通过分位数-分位数匹配目标替代 Epps-Pulley 目标，解决了 LeWorldModel 中潜在变量正则化梯度在尾部样本中消失的问题，提升了规划成功率与高斯对齐效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LeWorldModel (LeWM) 使用 Epps-Pulley (EP) 目标将潜在变量正则化为各向同性高斯分布，但 EP 的校正梯度在孤立的尾部样本中迅速消失，导致对重尾偏差的控制不足，影响规划性能。

Method: 提出 QQWorld，用分位数-分位数匹配目标直接对齐投影后的潜在样本与秩匹配的高斯分位数，从而在尾部保持有效的校正梯度；进一步提出跨批次 QQ，利用先前批次的分离样本扩大有效排序池，并分析了其偏差-方差权衡。

Result: 在四个控制环境中，QQWorld 有效提升了 LeWM 的平均规划成功率，同时实现了更好的高斯对齐和更薄的潜在变量尾部。

Conclusion: QQWorld 通过改进正则化目标，显著增强了潜在世界模型的规划能力，验证了分位数匹配在尾部处理上的优势。

Abstract: Latent world models enable efficient planning by predicting future states in a compact representation space, but their performance depends critically on the quality of the learned latent distribution. LeWorldModel (LeWM) regularizes its latents toward an isotropic Gaussian using the Epps-Pulley (EP) objective. We show that the corrective gradients of EP rapidly vanish for isolated tail samples, leaving heavy-tailed deviations insufficiently controlled. To address this limitation, we propose QQWorld, which replaces EP with a quantile-quantile matching objective that directly aligns projected latent samples with rank-matched Gaussian quantiles, thereby maintaining effective corrective gradients in the tails. We further develop cross-batch QQ, which enlarges the effective ranking pool using detached samples from previous batches, and characterize its bias-variance trade-off. Across four control environments, QQWorld effectively improves the average planning success rate of LeWM, while consistently yielding better Gaussian alignment and thinner latent tails.

</details>


### [293] [Recursive transformers for semiconductor thermo-mechanical reliability](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.27251)
*Kart-leong Lim*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文针对传统Transformer在低维小样本工程代理建模中参数量过大导致过拟合的问题，提出硬件感知评估三种递归Transformer范式（Tiny Recursive Model、提出的Depth Recursive Transformer、简单递归Transformer），在热机械可靠性分析和Laplace PDE求解两项任务上对比召回率、平均倒数排名、参数量和FLOPs，表明递归权重共享Transformer能在预测精度、参数效率和计算成本之间取得有效平衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统Transformer架构在处理工程设计中常见的小规模、低维数据集时参数过多，导致过拟合和内存/计算开销浪费，因此需要转向增加计算而非增加可学习参数的架构。

Method: 对三种递归Transformer范式（Tiny Recursive Model、提出的Depth Recursive Transformer、简单递归Transformer）进行硬件感知评估，在热机械可靠性分析（半导体封装应力和翘曲预测）和Laplace PDE迭代数值求解两项低维工程任务上系统比较召回率、平均倒数排名、参数量和FLOPs。

Result: 递归权重共享Transformer在参数量更少的情况下，能在预测精度、参数效率和计算成本之间取得有效的权衡，适用于小数据工程代理建模。

Conclusion: 递归权重共享Transformer为小数据工程代理建模提供了一种泛化性强、兼顾精度与效率的架构选择，建议在资源受限场景下优先考虑。

Abstract: Transformer-based surrogate models are increasingly used to replace expensive first-principles simulation in engineering design. But conventional transformer architectures are often over parameterized for the small, low-dimensional datasets typical of engineering design spaces, where large simulation data is expensive to generate. Under these conditions, excess parameter capacity leads to overfitting rather than improved accuracy, while also incurring unnecessary memory and compute overhead. This motivates a shift towards architectures that focus on additional compute rather than additional learnable parameters. This paper presents a hardware-aware evaluation of three recursive transformer paradigms for surrogate thermo-mechanical analysis of advanced packages: a)Tiny Recursive Model, b) our proposed Depth Recursive transformer, c) and a simple recursive transformer. We systematically compare their predictive performance (Recall, Mean Reciprocal Rank), parameter count, computational complexity (FLOPs), providing practical design guidelines for selecting recursive transformer architectures under resource-constrained scenarios. We validate this principle on two low-dimensional engineering prediction tasks: 1) thermo-mechanical reliability analysis of advanced semiconductor packages, where stress and warpage from thermal cycling must be evaluated repeatedly across a design-of-experiments sweep under costly finite element analysis (FEA). 2) Laplace PDE iterative numerical solver for capacitance field. Overall, recursive weight-sharing transformers provide an effective and generalizable trade-off between prediction accuracy, parameter efficiency, and computational cost for small data engineering surrogate modeling.

</details>


### [294] [Regularizing modality contribution drift in multimodal continual learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.27260)
*Zhen Zhang,Jielei Chu,Bin Liu,Tianrui Li*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种多模态持续学习中的模态贡献漂移（MCD）问题，并设计了持续模态贡献漂移正则化（CMCDR）方法，通过保持先前学习任务的模态贡献结构来缓解遗忘，包含基于回放和无回放两种版本，在多模态类增量学习和持续视觉问答任务上验证了有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有MMCL方法通常关注跨模态表示对齐或语义相似性，但忽略了增量任务中单个模态及其交互的相对贡献是否保持稳定；这种决策层面的偏移被称为模态贡献漂移（MCD），现有方法无法可靠地缓解该漂移。

Method: 提出CMCDR方法，通过保留先前学习任务的模态贡献结构来缓解MCD。基于回放版本：利用模态子集干预作为诊断探针，比较当前模型与冻结的旧模型在存储的旧样本上的贡献轮廓，约束旧样本的模态特定和交互贡献变化。无回放版本：使用当前任务样本作为探针，蒸馏冻结模型对旧任务的贡献响应，从而在无样本情况下正则化贡献轮廓。

Result: 在多模态类增量学习和持续视觉问答任务上的实验验证了CMCDR的通用性和有效性，表明该方法能有效缓解模态贡献漂移并提升持续学习性能。

Conclusion: CMCDR通过显式正则化模态贡献结构，弥补了现有MMCL方法忽视模态贡献漂移的不足，为多模态持续学习提供了一种有效的解决方案。

Abstract: Multimodal continual learning (MMCL) aims to learn emerging knowledge from multimodal data while preserving knowledge. To mitigate forgetting, current MMCL methods usually focus on cross-modal representation alignment or semantic similarity, but they overlook whether the relative contributions of individual modalities and their interactions remain stable across incremental tasks. We term this decision-level shift Modality Contribution Drift (MCD) and quantify it with the MCD score, which combines contribution-strength and relative-reliance changes under controlled interventions on modality subsets. Theoretical and empirical analyses further explain why current MMCL methods cannot reliably mitigate this drift. To this end, we propose Continual Modality Contribution Drift Regularization (CMCDR), which preserves the modality contribution structure of previously learned tasks. Since MMCL settings differ in whether old exemplars are available, CMCDR includes both replay-based and replay-free versions. The replay-based version uses modality-subset interventions as diagnostic probes on stored old samples, compares their contribution profiles between the current model and a frozen previous model, and constrains changes in old-sample modality-specific and interaction contributions. The replay-free version uses current-task samples as probes and distills the frozen model's old-task contribution responses, thereby regularizing the observed contribution profile without exemplars. Experiments on multimodal class-incremental learning and continual visual question answering validate the generality and effectiveness of CMCDR.

</details>


### [295] [DoTime: A Synthetic Benchmark Generator for Interventional and Counterfactual Time Series](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.27263)
*Dennis Thumm,Billy Tim Anthony,Ying Chen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: DoTime is an open, scalable, and theoretically grounded generator of multivariate temporal structural causal models (TSCMs) with interventions, providing benchmarks for causal inference over time series. It introduces capabilities such as continuous-time intervention windows, counterfactual sampling, regime-switching SCMs, non-stationary dynamics, and deterministic intervention profiles. The released suites include 100,000 trajectories and eight identification structures with exact ground truth. Experiments demonstrate that interventional training yields a measurable direction-accuracy advantage over observational models of identical capacity.


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Existing benchmarks for causal inference over time series are predominantly observational, small-scale, or domain-specific, leaving interventional and counterfactual estimation under-served in critical areas such as healthcare, policy evaluation, and climate science.

Method: DoTime generates multivariate temporal structural causal models (TSCMs) with interventions, featuring continuous-time intervention windows, counterfactual sampling modes with a positivity guard, regime-switching SCMs (a generalization of interrupted time series), non-stationary dynamics via switching SCM parameters, and deterministic ramp/sinusoidal intervention profiles. It is released as the `dotime` PyPI package with four frozen evaluation suites, reference baseline implementations, and an evaluation harness.

Result: The released suites span a training-scale snapshot of 100,000 trajectories and eight named identification structures, each with exact ground truth (paired interventional trajectories and shared-noise counterfactuals). Reference baseline implementations are provided. The interventional prior-fitted network (PFN) consistently outperforms an observational model of identical capacity, showing a positive direction-accuracy gap across every structure, trajectory length, and training seed tested.

Conclusion: DoTime addresses a critical gap in causal inference benchmarks by providing a scalable, theoretically grounded generator with interventions and counterfactuals. It also demonstrates the utility of interventional training as a prior for causal foundation models, validated across multiple structures and settings.

Abstract: Most benchmarks for causal inference over time series are observational, small, or domain-specific, leaving interventional and counterfactual estimation under-served exactly where it matters most, such as in healthcare, policy evaluation, and climate science. We introduce \textbf{DoTime}, an open, scalable, and theoretically grounded generator of multivariate temporal structural causal models (TSCMs) with interventions, released as the \code{dotime} PyPI package together with four frozen evaluation suites. Beyond existing work, it adds capabilities absent from prior generators: continuous-time intervention \emph{windows}, counterfactual sampling modes with a positivity guard, regime-switching SCMs as a strict generalization of interrupted time series, non-stationary dynamics by construction with switching SCM parameters, and deterministic ramp and sinusoidal intervention profiles that place trends and structural breaks \emph{inside} the evaluation window. Moreover, it demonstrates the suitability of the generator as a prior for a causal foundation model reference implementation. The released suites span a training-scale snapshot of $100{,}000$ trajectories and eight named identification structures, each with exact ground truth: paired interventional trajectories from the same SCM throughout, and shared-noise counterfactuals in the continuous-time suite. We ship reference baseline implementations with an evaluation harness, and pose a falsifiable claim: interventional training buys a measurable direction-accuracy advantage over an observational model of identical capacity. It is tested across three training seeds per arm. Under structure-matched evaluation on held-out episodes, the interventional prior-fitted network's (PFN) gap is positive in every structure, trajectory length, and seed tested.

</details>


### [296] [PlatformBid: An Auto-Bidding Benchmark from a Unified Advertising Platform's Perspective](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.27265)
*Shengtian Yang,Yewen Li,Peng Jiang,Zhiyi Lyu,Bo An,Peng Jiang,Qingpeng Cai,Lei Feng*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出 PlatformBid，一个从统一广告平台视角设计的全面自动出价基准测试，包含三种代表性竞争场景（同质、异质、促销），评估了多种现有方法并提出了基于流匹配的新方法 BidFlow，在快手在线实验中实现了目标成本 +0.68% 的提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有自动出价算法仅从 DSP 方考虑最大化广告主转化，而大型广告平台（如社交媒体、电商公司）已内部集成了 SSP、DSP 和 Ad Exchange 功能，需要同时优化广告主转化和平台总收入，但缺乏以平台为中心的评估框架。

Method: 提出了 PlatformBid 基准，包含三种竞争设置：同质竞争（所有广告主使用相同算法）、异质竞争（不同算法策略）和促销竞争（如黑五期间部分广告主增加预算）。系统评估了经典控制方法、基于 RL 的方法和生成式方法。并提出了基于流匹配的新方法 BidFlow，利用流匹配的表达性策略表示来应对动态竞争环境。

Result: 系统评估了多种自动出价方法在三种场景下的表现；在快手平台上的在线实验显示 BidFlow 在目标成本上提升了 +0.68%，验证了 PlatformBid 离线-在线一致性。

Conclusion: PlatformBid 是首个从统一平台视角出发的自动出价基准，BidFlow 方法在动态竞争环境中展现出有效性，为平台级自动出价研究提供了评估框架和新方法。

Abstract: Real-time bidding is central to computational advertising, comprising three elements: Supply Side Platform (SSP) selling ad impressions, Demand Side Platform (DSP) bidding for advertisers, and Ad Exchange conducting auctions between them. Traditional auto-bidding algorithms focus solely on the DSP side, maximizing advertiser conversions by adjusting bids against competitors. However, current big ad platforms, such as social media and e-commerce companies, now integrate SSP, DSP, and Ad Exchange functions internally. From such ad platforms' perspective, the goal of the auto-bidding algorithms is not only to maximize the advertisers' conversions, but also the total revenue of the platform. Given the lack of platform-centric evaluation frameworks and the pressing need to advance auto-bidding research, we propose PlatformBid - the first comprehensive benchmark designed from a unified ad platform's perspective. To accurately reflect the real-world auto-bidding scenarios, we define three representative settings: (1) homogeneous competition with identical algorithms across advertisers, (2) heterogeneous competition with diverse algorithmic strategies, and (3) promotional competition where some advertisers surge budgets for boosting sales during promotional events like Black Friday. We systematically evaluate a broad spectrum of existing auto-bidding methods across these settings, encompassing classical control methods, RL-based methods, and recent generative methods. Besides these methods, we further propose a novel auto-bidding method based on flow-matching, termed BidFlow, which leverages the flow-matching method's expressive policy representation to effectively handle dynamic competitive environments. Online experiments on Kuaishou further show a +0.68\% improvement in target cost, providing deployment evidence for the offline-online consistency of PlatformBid.

</details>


### [297] [Beyond KV Reconstruction: Functional Reconstruction for MLA Draft Models in Speculative Decoding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.27269)
*Weiye Shi,Fanxu Meng,Muhan Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出功能性重构（Functional Reconstruction）方法，解决MHA/GQA注意力架构向MLA转换后导致推测解码接受率下降的问题。该方法将MLA草稿构建视为功能重建而非缓存压缩，通过后转换优化使MLA注意力模块重现原始MHA/GQA的响应，在保持缓存效率和推理图不变的前提下，大幅提升推测解码的草稿令牌接受率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多头部潜在注意力（MLA）因用紧凑潜在状态替代增长的KV缓存，对长上下文LLM推理日益重要，但现有开源模型多用MHA/GQA，需转换才能获得MLA的缓存效率。推测解码可提供额外加速，但其加速效果取决于草稿提案与目标验证的匹配度。研究发现直接MHA/GQA-to-MLA转换会因低秩分解和RoPE处理引入注意力函数误差，虽对独立生成可容忍，但会显著降低草稿令牌接受率，因此需要新方法恢复转换后MLA的推测解码兼容性。

Method: 提出端到端（E2E）功能性重构方法：将MLA草稿构建重新定义为功能重建而非缓存压缩；对每个转换后的MLA注意力模块进行后转换优化，使其在校准隐藏状态上重现原始MHA/GQA经输出投影后的响应；该过程与转换器无关，保留转换后的缓存和推理图，且无需验证器logits或监督。

Result: 在192个模型-转换器-后端-方法-任务配置上（涵盖Llama/Qwen四个草稿-目标对、TransMLA和MHA2MLA转换器、HF和vLLM后端、四个200条提示的任务），采用0.5个百分点容忍度报告，功能性重构在64个匹配任务单元中实质性改善37个，26个基本不变，仅1个实质性下降。

Conclusion: 功能性重构能有效恢复MHA/GQA向MLA转换后推测解码的草稿接受率，且与具体转换器无关，无需额外的验证器监督，是一种实用、高效的后转换优化方案。

Abstract: Multi-head latent attention (MLA) is increasingly important for long-context LLM inference because compact latent states replace the growing key-value (KV) cache and reduce decoding memory traffic. Yet most capable open checkpoints use multi-head or grouped-query attention (MHA/GQA), so conversion is needed to obtain MLA's cache efficiency without retraining from scratch. Speculative decoding offers complementary acceleration, but its speedup depends on agreement between draft proposals and target verification. We find that direct MHA/GQA-to-MLA conversion can sharply reduce this agreement: low-rank factorization and RoPE handling introduce attention-function errors that may be tolerable for standalone generation but substantially lower draft-token acceptance. We therefore formulate MLA draft construction as functional reconstruction rather than cache compression. Our end-to-end (E2E) method optimizes each converted MLA attention module to reproduce the post-output-projection response of its original MHA/GQA counterpart on calibration hidden states. This converter-agnostic post-conversion procedure preserves the converted cache and inference graph and requires neither verifier logits nor verifier supervision. We evaluate 192 model-converter-backend-method-task configurations spanning four Llama/Qwen draft-target pairs, TransMLA and MHA2MLA, HF and vLLM, and four 200-prompt tasks. With a 0.5-percentage-point reporting tolerance, Functional Reconstruction materially improves acceptance in 37 of 64 matched task cells, leaves 26 practically unchanged, and materially decreases one. Code and evaluation artifacts are available at https://github.com/swyhahaha/FunctionalMLA.

</details>


### [298] [RLPF: Reinforcement Learning from Performance Feedback for Code Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.27271)
*Huihao Jing,Haozhe Cui,Wenbin Hu,Shaojin Chen,Haochen Shi,Changxuan Fan,Yuxuan Liu,Hanyu Yang,Sirui Zhang,Ziyi Chen,Haoran Li,Yangqiu Song*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出RLPF（基于性能反馈的强化学习），将执行结果转化为分阶段奖励：针对未通过程序按执行进度排序，针对正确程序按相对基线到专家参考的提升排序。在Qwen3-32B上微调后，正确且可运行解从11.1%提升至54.6%，相对效率从8.1%提升至38.6%，且性能迁移至EffiBench-X。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有代码模型训练大多仅以正确性为反馈信号，忽略了系统代码中两个通过相同测试的程序可能运行效率差异巨大的问题。训练信号应引导代码智能体不仅通过测试，还要生成更快的正确实现。

Method: 提出RLPF（Reinforcement Learning from Performance Feedback），设计分阶段奖励函数：对于未通过编译或运行的程序，按执行进度排序给予反馈；对于正确的程序，根据其相对于基线代码的性能提升以及与专家参考代码的对比进行排名，从而在正确性之前提供有用反馈，在正确性之后提供性能敏感反馈。

Result: 在PerfCodeBench上微调Qwen3-32B模型，正确且可运行解从11.1%提升至54.6%，相对效率从8.1%提升至38.6%。训练后的模型可与更强的开源模型竞争，优化行为可迁移至EffiBench-X。消融实验表明：模型生成的参考代码提供有用但较弱的监督，完整复合奖励比仅正确性或仅运行时的基线更可靠。

Conclusion: 代码智能体不仅可以被训练通过测试，还可以被训练优化其生成的代码的效率。RLPF通过分阶段奖励有效地弥合了正确性和性能之间的训练信号缺口。

Abstract: Code models are increasingly trained with execution feedback, but most training signals still stop at correctness. This leaves an important gap for systems code: two programs can pass the same tests while differing greatly in runtime. We study how to train code agents to prefer faster correct implementations, rather than treating efficiency only as an evaluation metric. The key difficulty is that runtime is a fragile reward. It is meaningful only after a program is correct, varies across tasks, and gives little guidance when most sampled programs fail to compile or run. We propose \textbf{RLPF}, reinforcement learning from performance feedback, which turns execution outcomes into a staged reward. Failed programs are ordered by execution progress, while correct programs are ranked by their relative improvement from the baseline toward the expert reference. This gives useful feedback before correctness and performance-sensitive feedback after correctness. Fine-tuning Qwen3-32B with RLPF on PerfCodeBench raises correct-and-runnable solutions from $11.1\%$ to $54.6\%$ and improves relative efficiency from $8.1\%$ to $38.6\%$. The trained model becomes competitive with stronger open-weight systems, and its optimization behavior transfers modestly to EffiBench-X. Additional studies show that model-generated references provide useful but weaker supervision, and that the full composite reward is more reliable than correctness-only or runtime-only baselines. These results suggest that code agents can be trained not only to pass tests, but also to optimize the programs they write.

</details>


### [299] [SDO: Structure-Aware Data Organization for Efficient LLM Post-Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.27273)
*Jinliang Gao,Ning Yang,Hai Wang,Baili Xiao,Pin Lyu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出SDO（结构感知数据组织）框架，通过曝光驱动的反馈机制，在每个epoch内利用KNN邻域遍历形成语义连贯的mini-batch，跨epoch记录样本参与度并降低过度曝光样本的采样概率，从而在SFT、DPO、GRPO等后训练中加速收敛，尤其在早中期阶段，产生更一致的梯度和更均衡的准确率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有后训练数据组织方式将数据分组视为静态预处理步骤，基于嵌入的分组方法在训练前构建固定分区，无法适应优化过程中样本曝光度的动态变化，导致所有样本获得相似的曝光度，造成部分样本冗余更新而另一些样本欠优化。

Method: SDO是即插即用的数据组织框架，包含两个核心组件：1）epoch内的局部感知批处理（Locality-aware batching），通过KNN邻域遍历形成语义一致的mini-batch；2）跨epoch的曝光均衡调度（Exposure-balanced scheduling），记录每个样本的参与次数，降低过度曝光样本的采样概率以保持长期覆盖。该方法基于冻结的外部嵌入逐epoch运行，无需模型预热训练。

Result: 在SFT、DPO、GRPO三种后训练范式上，SDO均加速了收敛，最大增益出现在早中期阶段，产生更一致的梯度，并在各问题类型上实现更均衡的准确率，且不会永久排除训练样本。

Conclusion: SDO通过动态曝光控制与结构感知批处理，有效解决了后训练中数据组织静态化导致的样本曝光不均问题，在多种对齐训练中提升收敛效率和准确性平衡，是一种轻量且通用的数据组织改进方案。

Abstract: Post-training of large language models is expensive, and existing efficiency improvements mainly focus on selecting informative samples or designing training schedules. However, data organization itself is usually treated as a static preprocessing step: embedding-based grouping methods construct fixed partitions before training and cannot adapt to the evolving sample exposure during optimization. As a result, all samples receive similar exposure despite their different optimization needs, leading to redundant updates for some samples while leaving others under-optimized. To address this problem, we propose SDO (Structure-Aware Data Organization), a plug-and-play data organization framework with an exposure-driven feedback mechanism that organizes mini-batch composition and sample exposure according to representation-space structure. SDO operates epoch by epoch on frozen external embeddings, avoiding model warm-up training overhead: within each epoch, locality-aware batching forms coherent mini-batches via KNN neighborhood traversal; across epochs, exposure-balanced scheduling records per-sample participation and reduces the sampling probability of over-exposed samples to preserve long-term coverage. Across SFT, DPO, and GRPO, SDO accelerates convergence, with the largest gains observed in the early-to-mid phase, producing more coherent gradients and more balanced accuracy across question types without permanently excluding training samples.

</details>


### [300] [Rethinking EEG-Based Disease Diagnosis: Decoupling Instance Representation Learning from Subject-Level Supervision](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.27274)
*Zhiyuan Ma,Zeyuan Li,Zhiyi Lu,Jiacheng Hao,Youlang Du,Zhen Jiang,Xinche Zhang,Yuhao Sun,Sen Song*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: BridgeMIL 是一种两阶段框架，将实例表示学习与主体级监督解耦，通过无标签预训练和注意力MIL聚合器，在EEG疾病诊断中显著优于传统实例级分类和端到端MIL方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统EEG疾病诊断将记录分割为短实例并继承主体标签，假设所有实例提供同等可靠的诊断证据，但这不合理。多实例学习(MIL)避免继承标签，但EEG数据集主体数远少于实例数，限制了端到端MIL学习表示的质量。

Method: BridgeMIL 分为两阶段：阶段1在无继承实例标签的情况下预训练编码器，通过对齐时间邻近窗口和独立采样的主体内子袋，并引入方差-协方差正则化防止坍塌和减少冗余；阶段2将编码器迁移至基于注意力的MIL聚合器，仅对主体预测施加监督，并通过特征保留限制表示漂移。

Result: 在3个EEG疾病数据集和5种骨干网络上，BridgeMIL在15个设置中取得14个最高平均准确率，总体平均准确率76.57%，比最强基线高4.28个百分点。进一步分析显示实例继承标签可靠性差异大，主体稀缺比实例稀缺影响更大，且表示空间形成更清晰的主体簇和更好的类别分离。

Conclusion: BridgeMIL证明将监督与主体级预测目标对齐，同时从大量EEG实例中学习而不为单个实例分配疾病标签，能显著提升诊断性能。这强调了在实例丰富但主体稀缺的场景下解耦实例表示学习与主体级监督的重要性。

Abstract: EEG-based disease diagnosis requires one prediction per subject, yet common pipelines segment recordings into short instances, inherit the subject label for every instance, and train instance-level classifiers. This assumes that all instances provide equally reliable diagnostic evidence. Multiple instance learning (MIL) avoids inherited labels by treating each subject as a bag. However, EEG datasets contain far fewer subjects than instances, which can limit the quality of the representations learned by end-to-end MIL. We propose BridgeMIL, a two-stage framework that decouples instance representation learning from subject-level supervision. Stage 1 pretrains the encoder without inherited instance labels by aligning temporally nearby windows and independently sampled within-subject sub-bags. Variance and covariance regularization prevent collapse and reduce redundancy without negative pairs. Stage 2 transfers the encoder to an attention-based MIL aggregator, applies supervision only to subject predictions, and limits representation drift through feature retention. Across three EEG disease datasets and five representative backbones, BridgeMIL attains the highest mean accuracy in 14 of 15 dataset-backbone settings and an overall mean accuracy of 76.57%, 4.28 percentage points higher than the strongest baseline. Further analyses reveal substantial variation in inherited-label reliability across instances, greater performance sensitivity to subject scarcity than to instance scarcity, and a more structured representation space with distinct subject-wise clusters and improved separation between diagnostic classes. Together, these findings underscore the importance of aligning supervision with the subject-level prediction objective while learning from abundant EEG instances without assigning disease labels to individual instances.

</details>


### [301] [Flat Score, Amplified Failures: How the Error Budget Masks Damage in Quantized LLM Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.27275)
*Jiwon Jang,Kisu Yang,Heuiseok Lim,Hyunwoo Park*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 针对4比特权重的后训练量化通常声称近乎无损，但本文通过多轮工具调用智能体测试发现，量化虽不改变标准指标得分，却显著放大模型已有的失败模式（如工具名称幻觉），且得分不变是因为基准测试的十错误预算吸收了额外错误。缩小预算至两个错误后得分差距重现，且仅出现在量化增加错误量的单元中。作者建议报告每通道错误率和紧缩预算下的成功率作为补充诊断。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 验证4比特后训练量化在多轮工具调用智能体场景下是否真正无损，重点关注量化对过程指标而非仅最终得分的影响。

Method: 在τ²-bench上对两个开放权重模型系列（稠密和MoE变体）、两个领域（共8个单元），每个单元456个回合，比较16、8、4比特权重的表现。采用标准指标、等价检验、排名相关、错误类型分析、紧缩预算（2错误）诊断、针对性修复提示等方法。

Result: 量化后标准得分无显著变化（经多重比较校正），但过程分析显示量化将模型已有的工具名称幻觉等失败放大至2.5倍（每个任务+17.6点错误率），且几乎不产生新失败类型（排名相关≥0.94，仅0.18%新事件）。得分不变是因为基准的十错误预算吸收了额外错误；缩小预算至2错误后得分差距重现（17点），且仅出现在量化增加错误量的单元。针对性修复提示精确消除量化损伤。

Conclusion: 标准指标掩盖了量化的过程损伤，建议在任务奖励之外补充报告每通道错误率和紧缩预算下的成功率作为诊断指标。

Abstract: Post-training quantization to 4-bit weights is widely reported to be nearly lossless. We test this claim for multi-turn, tool-calling agents, where it now matters most. On $τ^2$-bench, across two open-weight model families in dense and MoE variants and two domains (eight cells, 456 episodes each, at 16-, 8-, and 4-bit weights), quantization indeed looks free on the standard metric. No cell shows a score change that survives multiple-comparison correction, and in the cell that carries the largest process damage, equivalence testing bounds the change within $\pm$7.5 points. The process tells a different story. Quantization amplifies the failure the model already exhibits at full precision (tool-name hallucination in telecom, with the same directional trend in retail entity errors) by up to 2.5$\times$ in volume (+17.6 points per task), while creating essentially no new failures. The failure set is the same at every precision (rank correlation $\geq$ 0.94, 0.18% novel events). The score stays flat because the benchmark's ten-error budget absorbs the extra failures. Shrinking the budget to two errors re-exposes a score gap of 17 points, and it does so only in the one cell where quantization added error volume, exactly as the masking account predicts. A targeted error-repair prompt, run for five telecom models at every precision, removes the damage exactly and only where it lives. Both diagnostics, the per-channel error rate and success under a shrinking budget, come from logs benchmarks already collect; we suggest reporting them alongside task reward.

</details>


### [302] [The Kinetics of Training: A Driven-Nucleation Rate Law for Emergence, Plasticity Loss, and Circuit Control in Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.27281)
*Lei Dong*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Capabilities in language models emerge via a sudden, all-or-nothing alignment of circuit components, where partial credit is zero. This no-partial-credit joint alignment is the rate-limiting step, modeled as a rare event whose barrier grows with missing parts. The paper provides empirical fingerprints, a rate equation, forward/backward predictions, causal interventions, and a controlled proof, demonstrating that SGD's noise fails fluctuation-dissipation but can be fixed with annealing.


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Understanding how capabilities arise in large language models is crucial for interpretability, safety, and training efficiency. This paper aims to identify the fundamental rate-limiting step in capability formation and explain why capabilities sometimes fail to emerge despite low validation loss.

Method: The authors analyze transformer circuits using a combination of controlled experiments on simplified gated-attention models and large-scale studies on Pythia models up to 1.4B parameters. They formalize capability formation as a rare-event process with a barrier dependent on missing circuit parts, derive a rate equation, and test predictions via forward (ignition at a chosen step) and backward (delayed learning until critical point) preregistered experiments. They also perform causal intervention ablations and re-initialization experiments to isolate the mechanism.

Result: Key results include: (1) In shortcut-free circuits, missing three parts causes equal waiting regardless of total circuit size (ratio 1.19-1.37), confirming the barrier depends on missing parts count, not circuit size. (2) Ablating one part of a capability circuit leaves median 17% capability (vs. 50-83% expected under partial credit, p=2e-10). (3) Forward prediction: capability ignites at a chosen step when mixture passes a concentration floor (10/10 above, 0/12 below), and arrival can be dated from precursor with 5% median error. (4) Backward prediction: delay to learn a withheld capability grows until a critical step where it never ignites, while validation loss decreases smoothly. (5) The damage is circuit heads committing to base data; re-initializing query-key slices restores learnability (6/6), value slices do nothing (0/6). (6) SGD's noise fails fluctuation-dissipation test; installing annealed noise allows controlled circuit formation.

Conclusion: Capability emergence in transformers is an all-or-nothing rare event requiring joint alignment of all circuit parts, not gradual improvement. This explains sudden jumps in capability, failures despite low loss, and provides tools to predict, control, and repair capability formation. The findings suggest that standard training dynamics are suboptimal and can be improved by annealing noise to respect fluctuation-dissipation.

Abstract: A capability appears in a language model when the last parts of its circuit align in one stochastic attempt, and getting all but one right is worth nothing. We show this no-partial-credit joint alignment is the rate-limiting step of capability formation. Two fingerprints: in a shortcut-free apparatus a five-part circuit missing three waits as long as a three-part circuit missing three (1.19-1.37), so the wait counts missing parts, not size; and on Pythia across seven capabilities and three scales, ablating one part leaves a median 17% of the capability in 32 of 32 discriminating cells, where partial credit predicts 50-83% (p = 2e-10), while a random non-part head leaves 100%.
  One rare event whose barrier grows with missing parts yields a rate equation -- sites x attempts x drive x exp(-beta*K), minus destruction -- read three ways, each preregistered with frozen constants. Forward: a capability flat at baseline ignites at a step of our choosing once the mix passes a concentration floor (10/10 above, 0/12 below), and while still flat its arrival is datable from its precursor to 5% median error on six held-out models. Backward: the delay to learn a withheld capability grows with waiting until, past a critical step, it never ignites -- yet validation loss falls smoothly throughout, so standard monitors are blind to it. We locate the damage (heads commit to the base data) and isolate the cure: re-initializing only the query-key slices restores learnability (6/6) while the value slices do nothing (0/6). We prove the mechanism in a controlled gated-attention model: occupation forces a deadline whose consequences need no mixing assumption. Completed: SGD's noise fails the fluctuation-dissipation test, so we install one and anneal, melt and pin circuits on schedule. Scope: conjunction circuits in transformers to 1.4B.

</details>


### [303] [Benchmarking the Residual: What Long-Horizon Evaluations Add Beyond Matched Short-Task Performance](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.27283)
*Chao Peng,Zhiheng Lyu,Peijie Dong,Hande Dong,Qiang Lin*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: This position paper introduces the concept of "trajectory-induced degradation" and "context rot" to explain why agents fail in long-horizon tasks. It proposes using a "horizon residual" metric—the log-ratio between actual full-task success and a baseline prediction from short, individual stages—to quantify long-horizon failure. The paper argues that benchmarks must control for stage composition, checkpoints, information, and budgets to isolate degradation, and that further experiments are needed to explain the residual.


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Long-horizon benchmarks show agents fail more as tasks lengthen, but the cause is unclear: more stages increase opportunities for compounding errors, some decisions may be intrinsically harder, or earlier execution may degrade later conditions (trajectory-induced degradation). The paper aims to clarify how to properly measure and study long-horizon failure.

Method: The paper proposes the "horizon residual": the log-ratio between actual full-task success probability and a baseline prediction built from independent short stages (e.g., each stage's success rate). The comparison must use the same agent, specify stage definitions, checkpoints, information access, and budgets in advance. The residual quantifies deviation from the baseline, isolating trajectory-induced degradation and other long-horizon effects.

Result: No empirical results are presented; the paper is a position piece. It introduces the horizon residual as a diagnostic tool and outlines requirements for properly benchmarking long-horizon failures.

Conclusion: To claim long-horizon failure, benchmarks must compare full-task performance against a baseline from short stages. The horizon residual reveals whether degradation occurs, but targeted experiments are still needed to identify specific causes (e.g., context rot, harder decisions, error compounding).

Abstract: Long-horizon benchmarks often show that agents fail more as tasks become longer. This observation is useful for deployment, but it does not by itself explain why failure occurs. More stages create more opportunities for ordinary errors to compound; longer tasks may also contain harder individual decisions or become harder as conversation history, tool outputs, and environment changes accumulate. We use trajectory-induced degradation to mean this last possibility: earlier execution makes later work harder. When the harmful accumulation is specifically the text visible to the model, it is often called context rot. In this position paper, we argue that to claim a "long-horizon failure", benchmarks must compare actual full-task success against a baseline prediction built from short, individual stages. We call the log-ratio between this prediction and actual success the horizon residual. The comparison must use the same agent configuration and specify in advance how stages, checkpoints, information, and budgets will be chosen. The residual shows that the full rollout differs from the chosen baseline; targeted experiments are still needed to explain why.

</details>


### [304] [TIER-MoE: Trust-Informed Expert Routing via Conditional Modality Risk for Multimodal Fusion in Biomedical Classification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.27289)
*Yu Chang,Anzhe Cheng,Chenwei Wu,Zhuoran Wang,Jiahao Chen,Tamoghna Chattopadhyay,Sophia I. Thomopoulos,Paul M. Thompson,Liyue Shen,Paul Bogdan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 TIER-MoE，一种风险引导的子空间混合专家模型，通过定义样本级别的模态可靠性（即单模态预测器预期产生的预测损失），并结合专家子空间兼容性进行稀疏模态-专家路由，同时保留共享路径以确保多模态互补性。在四个多模态生物医学数据集上（阿尔茨海默病、皮肤病变恶性和视网膜分类），TIER-MoE 在预测性能和概率校准方面均优于现有方法，Macro-F1 和 Brier 分数持续提升，并展现出强大的零样本泛化能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有多模态融合模型虽然通过丰富的跨模态交互和样本自适应融合取得了进展，但融合过程中分配给某模态的影响力并不能揭示该模态是否不可靠、冗余或与特定专家不匹配。作者希望引入一种能显式量化模态可靠性的机制，从而更合理地分配模态权重。

Method: TIER-MoE 的核心创新包括：(1) 定义样本特定的模态可靠性为单模态预测器预期产生的预测损失，该风险通过未在当前样本上训练的模型所生成的 out-of-fold 预测来学习；(2) 将估计的风险与专家特定的子空间兼容性相结合，实现稀疏的模态-专家路由；(3) 设置始终激活的共享路径以保留多模态互补性。

Result: 在四个公开多模态生物医学数据集（阿尔茨海默病状态、皮肤病变恶性和视网膜分类）上的实验表明，TIER-MoE 在预测性能和概率校准方面均优于现有最先进方法，Macro-F1 和 Brier 分数持续提升，并在外部队列上展现出强大的零样本泛化能力。

Conclusion: TIER-MoE 通过风险引导的模态可靠性估计和子空间专家路由，有效解决了多模态融合中模态不可靠、冗余或专家不匹配的问题，为多模态学习提供了更鲁棒且可解释的融合框架。

Abstract: The promise of multimodal fusion lies in combining complementary sources of evidence, yet more evidence does not always yield a better prediction. Recent multimodal models have advanced fusion through richer cross-modal interaction and sample-adaptive fusion. However, the influence assigned to a modality during fusion does not reveal whether that source is unreliable, redundant, or poorly matched to a specialized expert. To address this limitation, we introduce TIER-MoE, a risk-guided subspace mixture-of-experts model that defines sample-specific modality reliability as the prediction loss its unimodal predictor is expected to incur. This risk is learned from out-of-fold predictions generated by models that were not trained on the corresponding sample. TIER-MoE combines the estimated risk with expert-specific subspace compatibility for sparse modality-expert routing, while an always-active shared path preserves multimodal complementarity. We evaluate TIER-MoE on four public multimodal biomedical datasets spanning Alzheimer's disease status, skin-lesion malignancy, and retinal classification. Results demonstrate its superiority over state-of-the-art methods in predictive performance and probability calibration, with consistent improvements in Macro-F1 and Brier score and strong zero-shot generalization to an external cohort.

</details>


### [305] [EvoCause: LLM-Guided Evolution of Causal Graphs for Root Cause Analysis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.27290)
*Lei Zan,Keli Zhang,Shifeng Xie,Jiale Zheng,Zehao Xiao,Zhiwei Dong,Ke Zhang,Ruichu Cai,Malik Tiomoko,Lujia Pan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: EvoCause is a method that refines causal graphs for root cause analysis (RCA) by incorporating expert diagnoses via LLM-proposed graph edits, improving upon traditional fixed-graph approaches. It also introduces TeleRCA, a large expert-annotated benchmark from production telecommunication networks.


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Existing RCA methods learn a fixed causal graph from observational logs, which cannot benefit from expert knowledge derived from historical incident diagnoses. Closing this feedback loop is essential for more accurate root cause identification.

Method: EvoCause uses a large language model (LLM) to propose semantically plausible edits to the causal graph, while deterministic validation ensures node identity and acyclicity; the best graph is retained using labeled alignment sets. At inference, the refined graph alone (without LLM) is used for transparent predictions.

Result: On synthetic data, EvoCause initialized with PC algorithm outperforms the unrefined PC baseline: Node F1, Case EM, and Graph F1 improve by 11.59, 9.40, and 4.59 percentage points respectively, while nSHD reduces by 0.2379. On the TeleRCA benchmark, replacing alarm titles with anonymous identifiers drops Node F1 by 6.12% and Case EM by 8.04%, confirming the importance of semantic alarm information in graph refinement.

Conclusion: Incorporating expert knowledge via LLM-based graph refinement significantly improves RCA performance. The semantic content of alarm names is crucial for effective graph edits. EvoCause presents a practical framework for integrating human expertise into automated RCA pipelines.

Abstract: Modern telecommunication, cloud, and microservice systems emit correlated alarm cascades when components fail. Root cause analysis (RCA) aims to identify the small set of alarms that initiate each cascade. A common approach learns a causal graph from observational logs and predicts all zero-in-degree alarms in each incident-induced subgraph. However, the learned graph remains fixed and cannot benefit from expert diagnoses of historical incidents. We close this loop with EvoCause. Expert labels constrain which alarms should be source nodes but do not specify the edge edits needed to satisfy those constraints. EvoCause uses a large language model (LLM) to propose semantically plausible graph edits, while deterministic code validates node identities and acyclicity and retains the best graph on a labeled alignment set. At test time, the refined graph alone produces transparent predictions without an LLM call. We also release TeleRCA, an expert-annotated benchmark from a production telecommunication network containing $485{,}681$ alarm events spanning $194$ alarm types over $5{,}621$ resources. On synthetic data, EvoCause initialized with the PC causal discovery algorithm outperforms the unrefined PC baseline, raising Node F1, Case EM, and Graph F1 by $11.59$, $9.40$, and $4.59$ percentage points, respectively, while reducing nSHD by $0.2379$. On TeleRCA, replacing human-readable alarm titles with anonymous identifiers lowers Node F1 and Case EM by $6.12$ and $8.04$ percentage points, respectively, indicating that alarm-name information contributes to graph refinement.

</details>


### [306] [THGFM: Dual-Branch Temporal Heterogeneous Graph Fusion Model](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.27303)
*Yixin Peng,Diego Collarana,Er Jin,Stefan Decker*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出THGFM，一种面向Web规模的时序异构图融合模型。它采用双路径架构：共享空间时序注意力分支实现跨类型参数高效迁移，关系类型分区时序注意力分支实现关系感知专化，并通过类型条件非竞争门控求和融合机制整合两条分支。同时引入旋转时序注意力，将相对时间以半相位旋转方式直接融入注意力计算。在多个学术图基准上，THGFM平均提升3.25%，其中OAG-CS PV上提升12.37%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有异构图时序学习方法难以兼顾跨类型参数高效迁移与关系感知专化，且通常仅将时间作为加性特征注入注意力核外，未能直接融入注意力分数计算。

Method: THGFM包含两条分支：共享空间时序注意力（跨类型参数高效迁移）和关系类型分区时序注意力（关系感知专化）；通过双路径关系-共享融合（类型条件非竞争门控求和融合）自适应整合；并引入旋转时序注意力，将相对时间以半相位旋转方式编码到查询和键中，直接参与注意力分数计算。

Result: 在学术图基准上，THGFM六任务平均增益+3.25%，峰值增益：OAG-CS PV +12.37%，PF-L2 +4.87%，PF-L1 +1.18%，OGBN-MAG +4.24%，HTAG-ArXiv +3.73%，HTAG-DBLP +4.61%。

Conclusion: THGFM通过双路径融合与旋转时序注意力，有效统一了跨类型迁移与关系专化，并直接建模相对时间，显著超越基线图Transformer模型。

Abstract: Temporal heterogeneous graphs offer a natural abstraction for dynamic relational systems in which diverse node and relation types co-exist and evolve over time. Learning on such graphs requires jointly modeling cross-type structural heterogeneity and the temporal dynamics of interactions, yet existing methods still struggle to reconcile parameter-efficient cross-type transfer with relation-aware specialization, and typically inject time only as additive features outside the attention kernel. We propose \textbf{THGFM}, a web-scale temporal heterogeneous graph fusion model that addresses both limitations within a unified dual-path architecture. THGFM couples a \textit{Shared-Space Temporal Attention} branch for parameter-efficient cross-type transfer with a \textit{Relational Type-Partitioned Temporal Attention} branch for relation-aware specialization, and integrates them through \textit{Dual-Path Relational--Shared Fusion}, instantiated with \textit{Type-Conditioned Non-Competitive Gated Sum Fusion}: a adaptive mechanism that assigns independent, type-conditioned feature-wise gates to the shared and specialized branches, allowing both to be amplified or suppressed without zero-sum competition. To directly incorporate relative time into the attention score, THGFM further introduces \textit{Rotary Temporal Attention}, which rotates queries and keys by half-phases of relative time before matching. THGFM consistently outperforms baseline graph transformer models on academic graphs benchmarks, delivering a $+3.25\%$ six-task mean gain, with peak relative gains of $+12.37\%$ on OAG-CS PV, $+4.87\%$ on PF-$L_2$, and $+1.18\%$ on PF-$L_1$, and $+4.24\%$, $+3.73\%$, and $+4.61\%$ on OGBN-MAG, HTAG-ArXiv, and HTAG-DBLP, respectively.

</details>


### [307] [Position, Not Provenance: Separating Reasoning Mediation from Sycophancy in Medical Vision-Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.27304)
*Supratik Bhowal,Subhrajyoti Basu,Aritra Gir Mahanta,Anik Pal Chowdhury*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 CoT-Mediate 框架，通过扰动模型自生成推理中的单个临床属性并测量预测是否跟随编辑后的推理，来检验医学视觉语言模型中链式推理是否因果性地影响预测。实验表明，推理注入机制显著影响测量到的忠实度，上下文位置而非声称的来源是决定模型是否使用其生成推理的主要因素。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 医学视觉语言模型（VLM）在回答临床问题前会生成链式推理（CoT），但这种推理是否因果性地影响预测尚不清楚。

Method: CoT-Mediate 行为框架包含双臂协议（重新提示证据 vs. 前缀强制延续）和来源受控干预（仅改变相同推理的归因来源以区分推理中介与谄媚）。在 LLaVA-Med 和 MedGemma 上评估 1,000 个 VQA-RAD 样本。

Result: 前缀强制延续比重新提示产生更高的中介忠实度；来源分析揭示模型特有的顺从行为；移除视觉证据增加对注入推理的依赖；侧别性（laterality）是最不忠实跟踪的临床属性。

Conclusion: 用于注入推理的机制显著影响测量的忠实度，上下文位置而非声称的来源是医学 VLM 是否使用其生成推理的主要决定因素。

Abstract: Medical vision-language models (VLMs) generate chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning before answering clinical questions, but whether this reasoning causally influences predictions remains unclear. We present CoT-Mediate, a behavioral framework that perturbs a single clinically meaningful attribute within a model's own generated reasoning and measures whether the resulting prediction follows the edited reasoning. Our framework combines a dual-arm protocol comparing re-prompted evidence with prefix-forced continuation, together with a provenance-controlled intervention that varies only the attributed source of identical reasoning to disentangle reasoning mediation from sycophancy. We evaluate LLaVA-Med and MedGemma on 1,000 VQA-RAD samples each. Prefix-forced continuation consistently yields higher mediation faithfulness than re-prompting, while the provenance analysis reveals distinct model-specific deference behaviors. Across both models, removing visual evidence increases reliance on injected reasoning, whereas laterality is the least faithfully tracked clinical attribute. These results show that the mechanism used to inject reasoning substantially affects measured faithfulness and that contextual position, rather than stated provenance, is the primary determinant of whether medical VLMs use their generated reasoning.

</details>


### [308] [ZUNA1.1: A more flexible EEG foundation model for Denoising and Super-resolution](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.27308)
*Christopher Warner,Jonas Mago,JR Huml,Beren Millidge*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: ZUNA1.1 是一个 380M 参数的扩散自编码器，用于灵活的脑电图信号重建，支持变长序列（最长 30 秒）、任意数量通道和任意空间位置，以及任意时间间隔的重建，性能与 ZUNA1 相当但更灵活，大幅优于标准方法（如球面样条插值），并以 Apache 2.0 开源。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的 EEG 重建方法（如球面样条插值）灵活性不足，难以处理变长序列、任意通道配置和任意时间间隔的重建任务。需要一种更灵活、通用的 EEG 信号重建模型。

Method: 采用 380M 参数的扩散自编码器架构，支持变长序列（最长 30s）、任意数量的 EEG 通道及任意头皮位置，能够重建整个通道或通道内的任意时间间隔。

Result: ZUNA1.1 性能与早期 ZUNA1 模型相当，但灵活度更高；大幅优于标准 EEG 去噪/重建方法（如 MNE 中的球面样条插值）。

Conclusion: ZUNA1.1 在保持高性能的同时实现了极高的灵活性，可处理多种 EEG 重建任务，并以开源方式发布（Apache 2.0），有利于社区应用和进一步开发。

Abstract: We introduce ZUNA1.1, a 380M-parameter diffusion autoencoder for flexible EEG signal reconstruction. ZUNA1.1 is capable of reconstructing variable length sequences of up to 30s, with an arbitrary number of EEG channels at arbitrary scalp locations, and can reconstruct arbitrary temporal intervals within channels in addition to reconstructing entire channels. We demonstrate that ZUNA1.1 performs at least on par with our earlier ZUNA1 model, while being far more flexible and capable of handling a wide range of reconstruction tasks. ZUNA1.1 continues to substantially outperform standard EEG denoising and reconstruction methods such as spherical spline interpolation, which is ubiquitously deployed in the MNE package. The ZUNA1.1 model is released open source under the permissive Apache 2.0 license.

</details>


### [309] [Modeling Decisions in Blockchain Analytics: A Leakage-Aware Evaluation of Tree-Based vs. Sequential Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.27350)
*Michał Bartnicki,Jarosław A. Chudziak*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种对抗标签泄漏的以太坊Sybil机器人检测框架，通过盲点协议消除高信号合约的捷径，并引入交易语法表示钱包行为（节奏、EVM执行结构、意图）。在泄漏感知评估下，XGBoost在性能和效率上均优于Transformer序列模型，表明对于实时监控，树模型比深度序列模型更实用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有Sybil检测方法过度依赖深度序列模型，但存在计算开销大、标签泄漏导致性能虚高的问题。亟需一种泄漏感知的轻量级方案，以准确区分有机用户、Sybil机器人和MEV机器人。

Method: 提出盲点协议（Blind-Spot）去除高信号合约的捷径；交易语法（Transaction Grammar）从节奏、EVM执行结构和意图三个维度建模钱包行为；使用Transformer、BiLSTM、XGBoost和SVM进行对比实验。

Result: 在泄漏感知设置下，XGBoost的分类性能优于Transformer和BiLSTM序列模型，同时延迟更低、能耗更小。表明交易顺序比交易时序提供更强的行为信号。

Conclusion: 泄漏感知评估至关重要；树模型（如XGBoost）在实时Sybil检测中比深度序列模型更具优势；交易语法是一种有效的钱包行为表示方法。

Abstract: Sybil bots are Ethereum actors that imitate legitimate users to extract airdrop rewards or influence governance. Recent Sybil detection methods increasingly use deep learning and treat blockchain activity as a quasi-linguistic sequence. However, complex sequence models are computationally expensive for real-time monitoring, and their reported performance may be inflated by label leakage from high-signal smart contracts.
